name: Foam Roller Quad Roll
steps: Lie face down on the floor in a forearm plank position with a foam roller positioned across the fronts of both thighs.
Brace your core to keep your lower back flat and use your forearms to glide your body forward and back over the roller.
Roll slowly from just below your hip flexors down to just above your kneecaps, slightly shifting angles to target the outer and inner quads.
Continue moving steadily through the full length of your thighs for the target duration.
tips: Keep your abs engaged so your lower back does not sag as you roll.
Stop above your kneecaps rather than rolling over the knee joints.
